Over the years, we have established a solid presence not only on the Italian market, but also in Europe, Asia and the United States. More SCENTED INKS Druckfarben srl produces SCENTED VARNISHES, water-based, solvent-based, acrylic, vinyl and U.V. Printables on paper, cardboard, plastic, metal, glass and fabric in flexo silkscreen, varnisher, lacquerer, offset, roto-offset, gravure, spray, manual brush… More MICROENCAPSULATION The “microencapsulation” technology allows one or more fat-soluble substances to be contained within a microscopic sphere, and to protect them from external agents. Our company is structured to produce laboratory quantities (1 kg) up to 8 tons per day. More PRODUCTS FOR TANNERIES Druckfarben srl produces thermoprinting paper rolls for the main leather measuring machines. We have been providing high quality and reliable solutions for the leather industry for over forty years. Our thermoprinting papers are specifically designed… More CHEMICAL INKS AND COATINGS Within our product line we specialize in the production of inks, coatings and adhesives for a wide variety of applications. In particular, we offer hot spot inks based on natural wax for the production of carbon paper. More SCENT YOUR PACKAGING Add our microencapsulated fragrances, or your own fragrances. Request information Our varnishes for your prints More than 100 fragrances available in our catalog. Lots of fragrances and in addition, the possibility of using the customer’s own essence.
